text:
Omar (Verdant Labs): Hey team — we have a customer showcase 09:00 CET tomorrow. Need temporary allowlist + TLS SNI mapping for eu-west-1, us-west-2 primary, and ap-southeast-1 fallback. Also want KV-cache pre-warm and edge warmup to cut cold-start latency. Request qps=2000 for a 9h window, auto-revoke at window end. CIDRs: 198.51.100.200/30, 203.0.113.0/26. Need header auth `x-verdant-apikey` and we'll provide cert for SNI mapping.
Jules (CS): Copy. Please confirm UTC start, steady vs peak, HSM/KMS keys for cert, and renewal timing. I'll tag renewal risk if budget sign-off is still outstanding.
Omar (Verdant Labs): Start = 08:00 UTC. Steady ~900 qps, short spikes to 2000 for 10m every 20m. We'll share the cert fingerprint and confirm no key rotation during window. Renewal is in 10 days — budget sign-off is pending, so flag as high risk. Please capture spend + perf for renewal call.
Marta (Network Ops): I need CIDR owner proof (whois/ticket) and the cert fingerprint. Also please confirm SNI hostname to map (e.g., `api.verdant.internal`). For auto-revoke TTL, what timestamp?
Theo (Solutions): Proposed auto_revoke = 2024-12-01T17:00:00Z (9h window). Draft push config — confirm before I apply:
```
{"customer":"verdant-labs","cidrs":["198.51.100.200/30","203.0.113.0/26"],"regions":["eu-west-1","us-west-2","ap-southeast-1"],"qps":2000,"duration":"9h","auto_revoke":"2024-12-01T17:00:00Z","allow_header":"x-verdant-apikey","sni_map":"api.verdant.internal","kv_prewarm":true}
```
Jules (CS): Flagged renewal status = "high". I'll schedule a pre-demo call and request a post-demo debrief. Also ask product for a recommended reserved capacity proposal given these spikes.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +20k tokens/hr for verdant-labs during window. Approve with `/approve quota 1748123456`
Jules (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark:
Marta (Network Ops): Applying to staging now. Staging smoke: `curl -I https://proxy.eu.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. I'll need the cert fingerprint to add SNI mapping. Planning prod cutover 20m before start.
Theo (Solutions): Running KV pre-warm script now: `rdwctl prewarm --customer verdant-labs --keys-file keys.txt --region eu-west-1` -> initial warmup started. Will post snapshot at 30m.
Marta (Network Ops): Prod config applied at 07:38 UTC, canary started 07:45 UTC. No errors in first 15m. Fallback to ap-southeast-1 ready at 75% util. SNI route mapped to api.verdant.internal.
Marta (Network Ops): Monitoring dashboards live. Alert rules: p50>200ms or 5xx>0.4% -> page oncall. Also set edge cache warmup TTL=60m.
Jules (CS): Noted. I'll collect token burn and perf snapshots (30m and 90m). Scheduling post-demo renewal prep for next week. Omar — please confirm if you want the reserved capacity scenarios (1k/2k/4k qps) sent ahead of renewal.
Omar (Verdant Labs): Yes please send 3 scenarios and include cost delta estimates. Also please save the perf snapshot after 1h for our ops team.
quota-bot: Quota change approved and active.
Theo (Solutions): Canary healthy, prod live at 07:46 UTC. KV warmup reported 98% hit-rate after 12m. Posting 30m perf snapshot to ticket.
Marta (Network Ops): Live watch active until 09:00 UTC then continue log retention for 48h. Good luck with the showcase! :rocket:
